sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.TAX_BILL_NO AS INVOICE_NO, A.DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, TX01.TEXT1 AS SAUPJ, TX06.TEXT1 AS DEPARTCODE, A.ISSUE_DATE AS INVOICE_DATE, TRIM(REPLACE(A.IRS_NO,'-','')) AS CUSTOMER, A.SUPP_PRICE AS AMOUNT, A.TOT_SUPP_PRICE AS TOT_AMOUNT, A.TAX_PRICE AS TAX_AMOUNT, A.TOT_TAX_PRICE AS TOT_TAX_AMOUNT, A.TAX_TYPE AS TAX_CODE, 1 AS TAX_COUNT, A.REMARK_DESCRIPTION || A.REMARK_SPECIFICATION AS REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID AS CREATE_EMPNO, A.ADD_DATE AS CREATE_DATE, A.SITE AS ATTRIBUTE1, DECODE(NVL(A.AR_TYPE,' '),'02','물류매출','상품매출') AS ATTRIBUTE3, A.EXP_CUR AS ATTRIBUTE9, NVL(A.EXP_CUR_PRICE,0) AS DAMOUNT, NVL(A.EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT,0) AS TOT_DAMOUNT, A.EXP_GR_NO AS ATTRIBUTE7, A.EXP_DATE_OF_SHIPMENT AS ATTRIBUTE8, '미등록' AS RECEIPT_TERM FROM KEPTARDT A INNER JOIN ICOMCOD1 TX01 ON (1 = 1 AND TX01.TYPE = 'TX01' AND TX01.CODE = A.KEP_IRS ) INNER JOIN ICOMCOD1 TX06 ON (1 = 1 AND TX06.TYPE = 'TX06' AND TX06.CODE = A.DEPT_CODE ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND ISSUE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2),'YYYYMMDD') AND IF_SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY A.TAX_BILL_NO, A.DEPT_CODE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEPTARDT A SET IF_SEND_FLAG = #IF_SEND_FLAG# , IF_SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TAX_BILL_NO = #INVOICE_NO# AND A.DEPT_CODE = #DEPT_CODE#
sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.TAX_BILL_NO AS INVOICE_NO, A.DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, TX06.TEXT1 AS DEPARTCODE, TX01.TEXT1 AS SAUPJ, A.ISSUE_DATE AS INVOICE_DATE, TRIM(REPLACE(A.IRS_NO,'-','')) AS CUSTOMER, TRIM(REPLACE(B.IRS_NO,'-','')) AS SALE_CUSTOMER, A.BUYER_CODE AS SITE_NO, A.SUPP_PRICE AS AMOUNT, A.TOT_SUPP_PRICE AS TOT_AMOUNT, A.TAX_PRICE AS TAX_AMOUNT, A.TOT_TAX_PRICE AS TOT_TAX_AMOUNT, A.TAX_TYPE AS TAX_CODE, 1 AS TAX_COUNT, A.REMARK_DESCRIPTION AS REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID AS CREATE_EMPNO, A.ADD_DATE AS CREATE_DATE, NVL(A.NTS_SEND_FLAG,' ') AS TRANSFER_FLAG, 'KA' AS ATTRIBUTE1, '익월25일기준60일어음' AS PAYMENT_TERM, '어음' AS PAYMENT_TYPE FROM KEPTAPDT A INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUSINESS_COND != 'S' AND A.BUYER_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.SITE = 'KA' ) INNER JOIN ICOMCOD1 TX01 ON (1 = 1 AND TX01.TYPE = 'TX01' AND TX01.CODE = A.KEP_IRS ) INNER JOIN ICOMCOD1 TX06 ON (1 = 1 AND TX06.TYPE = 'TX06' AND TX06.CODE = A.DEPT_CODE ) WHERE A.IF_SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.ISSUE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2),'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY A.TAX_BILL_NO, A.DEPT_CODE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
